module: Color palette and display constants (alphas, radii, widths) shared by the rally tools: snaproads, pacenotes, waypoints and the editor cursor. Contains no functions, only fields. The colors are {r, g, b} tables between 0 and 1, except clr_error and clr_no_error which are ImVec4 (ui_imgui).
notes: The colors are {r,g,b} tables without alpha: the alpha is provided separately (*_alpha* fields).
clr_error (1, 0.2, 0.2, 1) and clr_no_error (0.2, 1, 0.2, 1) are ImVec4 for imgui, not tables.

Other fields not listed individually: snaproads_* (radius 0.7, 0.5 recce, 0.2 driving; alphas 0.8/0.2/0.5; recce colors red, route orange), recce_* (driveline red, cut teal), pacenote_* (alphas, link widths 1.5 -> 0.25, interlink color pink), waypoint_* (cs green, ce red, adjacent variants and backgrounds, hover alphas 0.95/1.0), new_pacenote_cursor_* (link white, cs light green, ce light red, alpha 0.8).

cam_last_pos_radius.desc: Radius of the last camera position sphere: snaproads_radius x 2 = 1.4 m.

new_pacenote_cursor_alpha.desc: Alpha of the new pacenote cursor in the editor (0.8).

new_pacenote_cursor_clr_cs.desc: Color of the cursor's start point (CS): clr_light_green.

new_pacenote_cursor_clr_ce.desc: Color of the cursor's end point (CE): clr_light_red.
